components.text: On a distance-time graph, the slope of the line gives the speed. A steeper line means a greater speed.

components.prompt: Determine the cart's distance at t = 10 s.
components.answer: The slope between 2 s and 6 s is (30 m - 12 m)/(6 s - 2 s) = 4.5 m/s, so from 6 s to 10 s the cart travels 4.5 m/s × 4 s = 18 m; its distance at 10 s is 30 m + 18 m = 48 m.
components.scenario: A distance-time graph shows a cart at 12 m when t = 2 s and 30 m when t = 6 s; after 6 s it travels at the same speed for 4 more seconds.

components.text: pH is the negative base-ten logarithm of the hydrogen ion concentration: pH = -log10[H+].

components.prompt: Calculate the pH before dilution and after dilution.
components.answer: Before dilution, pH = -log10(2.0×10^-4) ≈ 3.70; after dilution, pH = -log10(5.0×10^-5) ≈ 4.30.
components.scenario: A beaker contains 0.00020 M H+ ions. After dilution with water, the concentration becomes 0.000050 M H+.
